capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Wikipedia: assessed usable 21.381 kWh of 24.15 kWh nominal (EV Database shows 22 kWh, estimated).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Press kit says "24 kWh" laminated lithium-ion (bare capacity, taken as gross).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: DOE/INL sheet for the 2013 Leaf (specs supplied by Nissan): AESC lithium manganese oxide (LMO) cathode, carbon anode. "other" = LMO (no LMO enum value). UNPROVEN carry-over: the DOE sheet is for a 2013 car; no page found showing whether the 2011-12 and 2014-16 24 kWh cells kept the same cathode. EV Database lists NMC for these years, which conflicts.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: DOE/INL sheet: nominal system voltage 364.8 V (96S), 2013 car; same pack in other 24 kWh years. Classed 400v (sub-400 V pack).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: EV Database states battery preconditioning is not supported (or "No") for this pack. Nissan US press kits (2012, 2013, 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024) describe only remote cabin heating/cooling (NissanConnect EV) and, in 2012-2014, a cold-weather battery heater that warms the pack while charging; none describes a navigation or manual battery-warming-before-charging feature. Nissan's navigation-linked battery heater first appears on the third-generation LEAF.

dc_max_kw.notes: Quick charge port "-" on the SV (US 2012 kit, Canada 2011 and 2012 sheets): no DC charging on this trim.
